title: Estimate from Photos or Video
subtitle: Photos, video, renderings and your own notes — a preliminary estimate without a site visit.
disclaimer: No AI yet: detections come from fixed keyword rules over what you write or say. Every assumption is shown and editable.

cta.description: Upload photos and renderings, describe the renovation, get ranges in minutes.

project.title: Project
project.none: Create a project first, or continue without linking one.

media.title: Photos and renderings
media.hint: Photos are saved to this project and stay available on every device.
media.error: Some photos could not be saved. Try again.
media.needsProject: Select a project first so photos are saved to it.

describe.title: Describe the renovation
describe.hint: Talk the way you would to the homeowner. Example: “Remove the wall between the kitchen and dining room, install an LVL beam, replace all cabinets…”
describe.unsupported: Speech recognition isn't available in this browser — type the description instead.

detected.title: What we found
detected.empty: Nothing detected yet — add more detail to the description.

assumptions.title: Assumptions
assumptions.hint: We filled in what wasn't said. Change anything that's wrong.

levels.title: Estimate levels
levels.empty: Describe the renovation to see estimate levels.
levels.unpricedHint: These are excluded from the range above. Add a measurement or an allowance in the detailed estimate.

unpricedReason.no_mapping: no catalog assembly matches this work yet
unpricedReason.missing_assembly: the mapped catalog assembly is unavailable
unpricedReason.unit_incompatible: the stated size doesn't match how this assembly is sold
unpricedReason.no-quantity: no confirmed quantity or measurement to price against
unpricedReason.no-trade: the trade for this work isn't determined yet
unpricedReason.fee-basis: priced as a fee or permit, not production work
unpricedReason.unknown: needs review before it can be priced

levels.allowanceTitle_one: 1 item priced from a standard allowance
levels.allowanceTitle_other: {{count}} items priced from a standard allowance
levels.allowanceReason: no size stated — priced from a standard allowance
levels.allowanceHint: These are included in the ballpark range using an estimated allowance. Confirm the actual size for the detailed estimate.

prompt.plumbing_location: Is existing plumbing staying in place?
prompt.window_count: How many windows are being replaced?

scope.title: Scope of Work
scope.hint: Generated from your description and assumptions. Edit only if you want to.
scope.saveHint: Approving saves this scope of work, your description and measurements to the project.
scope.needsProject: Select a project above so approving saves this scope of work to it.

proposal.title: Proposal Scope of Work
proposal.subtitle: Exactly what the customer sees.
proposal.notApproved: Approve the scope to generate the proposal.

toast.committed: Scope approved and saved to the project
toast.commitFailed: Could not save to the project. Try again.

video.title: Prerecorded walkthrough video
video.hint: Upload a walkthrough you already recorded on your phone — it doesn't have to be recorded in VisionWorx360.
video.noProject: Choose a project above to store the video with the project.
video.limits: MP4, MOV or WebM · up to {{maxMb}} MB and {{maxMinutes}} minutes.
video.evidence: Video is evidence, not measurements. Add dimensions yourself in Add project details.

errors.unsupported_type: That file type isn't supported. Use MP4, MOV or WebM.
errors.too_large: That video is larger than {{maxMb}} MB. Trim it or split it into shorter clips.
errors.too_long: That video is longer than {{maxMinutes}} minutes. Split it into shorter clips.
errors.upload: Upload failed. Check your connection and try again.

details.title: Add project details
details.hint: Add anything the media doesn't show. You can save and come back later.

voice.title: Record details
voice.placeholder: Your spoken notes appear here — edit freely.
voice.unsupported: Speech recognition isn't available in this browser — type your notes instead.

notes.title: Typed notes
notes.placeholder: Notes, instructions, anything the customer said…

dimensions.title: Measurements
dimensions.hint: Optional. Only what you actually measured.

ledger.title: What this estimate is based on
ledger.hint: Your own words and measurements are facts. Photos and video are observations only.

interpreted.title: Scope interpreted from your input
interpreted.hint: Only what you asked for is priced. Review it before the ballpark.
interpreted.incidental: Assumed / required to complete the work
interpreted.blocked: Pricing is paused until these are resolved.
interpreted.empty: Nothing interpreted yet — add a description or voice note.

measurements.title: Measurements
measurements.hint: Speak them, type them, or upload a plan. We'll turn them into a list you can check.

speak.placeholder: e.g. Bedroom is 12 by 14 with 8 foot ceiling. The counter run is 12 feet.

type.title: Type measurements
type.placeholder: One per line or all in a paragraph: Bathroom 5 by 9. Vanity 60 in. Back wall 7' 10".

plan.hint: Upload a photo or PDF of a sketch, floor plan, or measurement sheet. We read the dimensions printed on it.
plan.reviewNote: Plan readings are suggestions until you confirm them. Nothing from a plan prices the job on its own.

errors.extraction_failed: We couldn't read that plan. Try a clearer photo, or type the measurements.
errors.extraction_unavailable: Plan reading isn't available right now — type the measurements instead.
errors.extraction_blocked: Plan reading is unavailable on this workspace right now.
errors.rate_limited: Too many requests just now. Try again in a moment.
errors.plan_too_large: That file is too large to read. Try a photo of the page.
errors.no_measurements: No dimensions were legible on that page.
errors.unsupported_type: Upload a PDF or a photo (JPG, PNG, WEBP).
errors.upload_failed: The upload didn't finish. Try again.

technical.hint: How this was calculated — status and audit information only. Nothing here needs your input.

draftPreview.title: Preliminary preview — not saved yet
draftPreview.body: These numbers come from the draft replay of this walkthrough. The saved estimate on the project's Estimate tab is the authoritative price.
